title: A category on the General Matrix has a grayed Edit and a General Matrix link
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, on the General Matrix.
  • Note the count in the General Matrix's Categories cell on the Matrices list (for example 9).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Point at the grayed Edit.
  4. Click Go to the General Matrix.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit is grayed.
  • A link beside it reads "Go to the General Matrix".
  • Above the grid a line reads "The General Matrix also prices every other category without a matrix of its own" with a count in brackets.

Step 3:

  • A tooltip reads "Can't edit here. The General Matrix prices" the noted count "categories, so edit it from the matrix." (same count as the Matrices list).

Step 4:

  • The General Matrix's page opens with its grid already in edit.
